notes.title: New Map Layout!
notes.content: The map's laid out differently, designed to show off what we have so far.

notes.title: New Level: The Sandbox!
notes.content: Sergeant has been hard at work at a big new level, and it's finally in! We've also updated to Godoto 4.3 rc2, which should have many performance improvements.

notes.title: Variable Jump Heights
notes.content: Not every jump is the same height anymore, a quick press of the jump button results in a shorter hop now, whereas holding it briefly has the same height as usual. Running up walls is easier now too!

notes.title: Added "Wind Tunnel" Spell
notes.content:
Finally a useful spell, use it to propel yourself into the air!
Play the following notes: Down, Left, Right, Left, Right, Up.

Also fixed the floating water ripples.
